cards.text: Untuk sesuatu yang dimulai di masa lalu dan masih berlanjut sekarang, pakai present perfect, bukan present simple.

examples.en: How long have you been married?
I've lived here for five years.
examples.id: Saya sudah tinggal di sini lima tahun.

cards.trap: Kesalahan khas: "Saya tinggal di sini sejak 2019" diterjemahkan I live here since 2019. Yang benar: I have lived here since 2019.

cards.text: Untuk how long, bentuk continuous lebih umum. Tetapi kata kerja keadaan (know, like, have = punya) tetap simple.

examples.en: I've been learning English since January.
examples.id: Saya belajar bahasa Inggris sejak Januari.

examples.en: How long have you known Rina?
examples.id: Sudah berapa lama kamu kenal Rina?

cards.text: live dan work boleh simple atau continuous. Dengan always, pakai simple.

examples.en: She has worked here for a long time. / She has been working here ...
examples.id: Dia sudah lama bekerja di sini.

cards.text: I haven't ... since/for ... dipakai untuk mengatakan kapan terakhir kali sesuatu terjadi.

examples.en: I haven't seen her since June.
examples.id: Saya tidak bertemu dia sejak Juni.

questions.why: Menanyakan lama sesuatu yang masih berlanjut memakai present perfect: have you lived.

questions.prompt: We ___ (know) each other since primary school.
questions.why: know adalah kata kerja keadaan, jadi present perfect simple: have known.

questions.prompt: I am working here for three years.
questions.answer: I have been working here for three years.
accept: I have worked here for three years.
questions.why: Untuk lama waktu sampai sekarang, pakai present perfect, bukan present continuous.

questions.prompt: Susun pertanyaan: "Sudah berapa lama mereka menikah?"
questions.answer: How long have they been married?
questions.why: be married sampai sekarang memakai present perfect: have they been married.

questions.prompt: I haven't seen Ali ___ last Friday.
questions.why: last Friday adalah titik awal waktu, jadi pakai since.

questions.answer: I have lived in Jakarta since 2018
accept: I have been living in Jakarta since 2018
questions.why: Sesuatu yang dimulai di masa lalu dan masih berlanjut memakai present perfect, bukan I live.
Dengan always untuk periode sampai sekarang, pakai present perfect simple: has always wanted.

questions.prompt: Jodohkan situasi dengan kalimat yang tepat.
pairs: We've known each other for years.
He's had it for two years.
Raka is waiting for a bus.
He's been waiting for ten minutes.
questions.why: Kalimat kiri memakai present (keadaan sekarang); kalimat kanan memakai present perfect untuk menyatakan sudah berapa lama.
Sakit sejak Minggu sampai sekarang, jadi present perfect: has been.

questions.prompt: How long have you had this car?
questions.answer: How long have you had this car?
questions.why: Kalimat ini sudah benar: have (punya) memakai present perfect simple untuk lama waktu.
